source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Chapter 2 (PDF 22-53), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 2 (Force and Motion) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har 5 number ke theory sawal (definition, wazahat, derivation) ke baad usi mauzu ka 3 number ka numerical hai. Har sawal ka model jawab hai; numericals qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 What are rectangular components of a vector? Find the rectangular components of a vector A making an angle θ with the x-axis, and show how the magnitude and direction of A are found from its components. (5 marks)
(Vector ke rectangular components kya hain? x-axis se θ angle banane wale vector A ke rectangular components nikalein, aur dikhayein ke components se A ki magnitude aur simt kaise maloom hoti hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Component: kisi rukh mein vector ki effective (moassar) qeemat. Aapas mein amoodi rukhon ke components rectangular components kehlate hain.

Resolution (tajziya): Vector A ko line OP se zahir karein jo x-axis se θ angle banati hai (Fig. 2.1). x-axis par projection OM aur y-axis par ON banayein. OM se Ax aur ON (= MP) se Ay zahir hota hai. Head to tail rule se:
A = Ax + Ay ... (2.1)
Qaima zaviya tikon OMP se:
Ax = A cos θ ... (2.2)
Ay = A sin θ ... (2.3)

Components se magnitude: Pythagorean theorem se
(OP)² = (OM)² + (MP)², yani A² = Ax² + Ay² ... (2.4)
A = √(Ax² + Ay²)

Simt: tan θ = MP/OM = Ay/Ax, is liye θ = tan⁻¹(Ay/Ax) ... (2.5)

book_ref.quote: By applying head to tail rule:

blocks.prompt:
2 A force of 6 N acts along the x-axis and a force of 8 N acts at 60° to the x-axis on the same body. Find the magnitude and direction of their resultant. (3 marks)
(Aik jism par 6 N ki force x-axis par aur 8 N ki force x-axis se 60° par amal karti hai. Un ke resultant ki magnitude aur simt nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: x-components aur y-components alag alag jama karein, phir Pythagoras aur tan⁻¹ lagayein.

book_ref.quote: Let θ be the angle between two forces F₁ and F₂, where F₁ is along x-axis.

blocks.prompt:
3 Define the scalar product of two vectors and give its physical interpretation. Show that work is a scalar product. Also write the scalar product in terms of rectangular components and use it to find the angle between two vectors. (5 marks)
(Do vectors ke scalar product ki definition aur tabeei tashreeh likhein. Sabit karein ke work scalar product hai. Rectangular components ki shakal mein scalar product likhein aur us se do vectors ke darmiyan angle nikalne ka tareeqa batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: A aur B ka scalar product A.B = AB cos θ ... (2.6), jahan A aur B magnitudes aur θ un ke darmiyan angle hai. Nateeja scalar hai.

Tabeei tashreeh: A aur B ko aik hi origin par layein (Fig. 2.2).
A.B = A (B ka A par projection) = A (B cos θ) = AB cos θ
Isi tarah B.A = B (A cos θ) = BA cos θ

Work bator scalar product: Force F apne point of application ko apni line of action se θ angle par d faasla le jati hai (Fig. 2.3).
Work = (harkat ke rukh mein force ka effective component) × faasla = (F cos θ)d = Fd cos θ
Vector shakal mein: F.d = Fd cos θ = work

Rectangular components ki shakal mein:
A.B = AxBx + AyBy + AzBz ... (2.7)
Chunke A.B = AB cos θ, is liye
cos θ = (AxBx + AyBy + AzBz)/AB ... (2.8)

Khususiyaat: A.B = B.A (commutative); amoodi vectors ke liye A.B = 0; mutawazi ke liye AB aur antiparallel ke liye -AB; A.A = A².

book_ref.quote: The scalar product of two vectors A⃗ and B⃗ is written as A⃗.B⃗ and is defined as

blocks.prompt:
4 Vector A has components Ax = 2, Ay = 3, Az = 6 and vector B has components Bx = 3, By = 4, Bz = 0. Find A.B and the angle between A and B. (3 marks)
(Vector A ke components Ax = 2, Ay = 3, Az = 6 aur vector B ke Bx = 3, By = 4, Bz = 0 hain. A.B aur A aur B ke darmiyan angle nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Components se A.B, Pythagoras se dono magnitudes, phir cos θ = A.B/AB.

book_ref.quote: Equation (2.6) can be used to find the angle between two vectors. Since,

blocks.prompt:
5 Define the vector product of two vectors. How is its direction found? Describe its characteristics and give two examples from physics. (5 marks)
(Do vectors ke vector product ki definition likhein. Us ki simt kaise maloom hoti hai? Us ki khususiyaat aur physics se do misalein bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: A aur B ka vector product aik vector hai:
A × B = AB sin θ n̂ ... (2.9)
jahan n̂ A aur B wale plane par amoodi unit vector hai.

Simt (right hand rule): A aur B ki tails mila kar un ka plane banayein. Product vector is plane par amoodi hai. Pehle vector A ko chhote angle se B ki taraf ghumayein, daayen haath ki ungliyan ghumao ke rukh mein mor kar angootha seedha rakhein; angootha A × B ki simt batata hai (Fig. 2.4 b).

Khususiyaat:
1. Non-commutative: A × B ≠ B × A; balkay A × B = -B × A ... (2.10)
2. Amoodi vectors (θ = 90°) ke liye magnitude sab se zyada: A × B = AB n̂
3. Mutawazi vectors (θ = 0° ya 180°) ke liye null vector; is liye A × A = 0
4. |A × B| us parallelogram ke area ke barabar hai jis ke mutasil sides A aur B hain (Fig. 2.4 d)

Misalein:
(i) Torque: τ = r × F.
(ii) Magnetic field B mein velocity v se chalte charge q par force: F = q(v × B).

book_ref.quote: place together the tail of vectors A⃗ and B⃗ to define the plane of vectors A⃗ and B⃗

blocks.prompt:
6 Two vectors of magnitudes 6 units and 4 units make an angle of 30° with each other. Find (i) the magnitude of their vector product (ii) their scalar product (iii) the area of the parallelogram having these vectors as adjacent sides. (3 marks)
(6 units aur 4 units magnitude ke do vectors aapas mein 30° ka angle banate hain. Nikalein: (i) un ke vector product ki magnitude (ii) un ka scalar product (iii) un vectors ko mutasil sides bana kar parallelogram ka area.)
blocks.explanation: Cross product (aur area) ke liye AB sin θ aur dot product ke liye AB cos θ lagayein.

book_ref.quote: The magnitude of A⃗ x B⃗ is equal to the area of the parallelogram

steps: Parallelogram ka area = |A × B| = 12 square units
blocks.final_answer: |A × B| = 12 units; A.B = 20.8 units; area = 12 square units

blocks.prompt:
7 State the condition under which the equations of motion apply. Derive the first equation of motion (i) from the definition of acceleration (ii) from the velocity-time graph. (5 marks)
(Equations of motion kis shart par lagti hain? Pehli equation of motion (i) acceleration ki definition se (ii) velocity-time graph se derive karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Shart: Equations of motion sirf seedhi line mein mustaqil acceleration se chalne wale ajsaam par lagti hain. Pehli equation velocity aur time ko jorti hai.

(i) Acceleration ki definition se: Yaksaan acceleration a se chalte jism ki velocity t waqt mein vi se vf ho jati hai. To
a = (vf - vi)/t
vf - vi = at
vf = vi + at ... (2.11)

(ii) Graph ka tareeqa: Velocity-time graph (Fig. 2.5) mein A par velocity vi aur t waqt baad B par vf hai. B se x-axis par amood BD aur y-axis par amood BE banayein.
OA = vi, BD = vf
BD = BC + CD = BC + OA (kyunke OA = CD)
vf = BC + vi ... (2.12)
Line AB ka slope acceleration hai: a = BC/AC, aur AC = t, is liye BC = at ... (2.13)
(2.12) aur (2.13) milane se: vf = vi + at.
Yeh pehli equation of motion hai.

book_ref.quote: A perpendicular BD is drawn from point B to x-axis

blocks.prompt:
8 A bus moving at 4 m s⁻¹ accelerates uniformly at 1.5 m s⁻² for 8 s. Find its final velocity. How long would it take to reach 25 m s⁻¹ from the start? (3 marks)
(4 m s⁻¹ se chalti bus 8 s tak 1.5 m s⁻² se yaksaan acceleration karti hai. Us ki final velocity nikalein. Shuru se 25 m s⁻¹ tak pohanchne mein kitna waqt lagega?)
blocks.explanation: Velocity ke liye vf = vi + at, phir waqt ke liye t = (vf - vi)/a.

book_ref.quote: Above equation is the first equation of motion.

steps: Diya gaya: vi = 4 m s⁻¹, a = 1.5 m s⁻², t = 8 s
vf = 25 m s⁻¹ ke liye: t = (25 - 4)/1.5 = 14 s
blocks.final_answer: 8 s baad vf = 16 m s⁻¹; 25 m s⁻¹ par 14 s baad

blocks.prompt:
9 Derive the second equation of motion S = vit + ½at² (i) by using average velocity (ii) by the graphical method. (5 marks)
(Doosri equation of motion S = vit + ½at² (i) average velocity se (ii) graph ke tareeqe se derive karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Average velocity se: Yaksaan acceleration a wale jism ki initial velocity vi, t waqt baad final velocity vf aur displacement S hai. Velocity mustaqil nahi, is liye average velocity lete hain:
Displacement = average velocity × time
S = (vi + vf)/2 × t
Pehli equation vf = vi + at rakhne se:
S = (2vi + at)/2 × t
2S = 2vit + at²
S = vit + ½at² ... (2.14)

(ii) Graph ka tareeqa: Velocity-time graph (Fig. 2.6) mein displacement graph ke neeche ke area ke barabar hai:
S = OABD ka area = rectangle OACD ka area + triangle ABC ka area
S = (OA × OD) + ½(AC × BC)
OA = vi aur OD = AC = t: S = vi × t + ½(t × BC)
Pehli equation (graph) se BC = at:
S = vit + ½at²
Yeh doosri equation of motion hai.

book_ref.quote: While moving with constant acceleration a it covers a displacement S in time t.

blocks.prompt:
10 A cyclist moving at 3 m s⁻¹ accelerates uniformly at 0.4 m s⁻² for 10 s. Find the distance covered in this time and the final velocity. (3 marks)
(3 m s⁻¹ se chalta cyclist 10 s tak 0.4 m s⁻² se yaksaan acceleration karta hai. Is waqt mein tay kiya faasla aur final velocity nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Faasle ke liye S = vit + ½at², velocity ke liye vf = vi + at; S = (vi + vf)/2 × t se jaanch lein.

book_ref.quote: This is the second equation of motion.

steps: Diya gaya: vi = 3 m s⁻¹, a = 0.4 m s⁻², t = 10 s

blocks.prompt:
11 Derive the third equation of motion 2aS = vf² - vi² (i) from the average velocity (ii) by the graphical method. How are these equations applied to freely falling bodies? (5 marks)
(Teesri equation of motion 2aS = vf² - vi² (i) average velocity se (ii) graph ke tareeqe se derive karein. Yeh masawaat azadana girte ajsaam par kaise lagti hain?)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Average velocity se: Seedhi line mein chalte jism ki initial velocity vi, t baad final velocity vf aur displacement S hai.
S = (vi + vf)/2 × t, is liye 2S = (vi + vf) × t ... (2.15)
Pehli equation se t = (vf - vi)/a. (2.15) mein rakhne se:
2S = (vf + vi)(vf - vi)/a
2aS = vf² - vi²

(ii) Graph ka tareeqa: Velocity-time graph (Fig. 2.7) mein faasla S graph ke neeche area OABD hai jo trapezium hai:
S = ½ (mutawazi sides ka majmua) × unchai = ½ (OA + BD) × OD
OA = vi, BD = vf, OD = t: S = ½(vi + vf) × t
Pehli equation se t = (vf - vi)/a, is liye
S = ½(vf + vi)(vf - vi)/a
2aS = vf² - vi² ... (2.16)

Free fall: Hawa ki rukawat na ho to ajsaam yaksaan acceleration g (average 9.8 m s⁻², neeche) se girte hain. a = g rakhne se:
vf = vi + gt; h = vit + ½gt²; vf² - vi² = 2gh
Girte jism (vi = 0) ke liye g positive aur oopar phainke gaye ke liye negative.

book_ref.quote: In the speed time graph shown in the figure

blocks.prompt:
12 A car moving at 90 km h⁻¹ is brought to rest with uniform retardation in a distance of 125 m. Find (i) its acceleration (ii) the time taken to stop. (3 marks)
(90 km h⁻¹ se chalti car yaksaan retardation se 125 m ke faasle mein ruk jati hai. Nikalein: (i) us ka acceleration (ii) rukne ka waqt.)
blocks.explanation: km h⁻¹ ko m s⁻¹ mein badlein, 2aS = vf² - vi² lagayein (waqt diya nahi), phir waqt ke liye vf = vi + at.

book_ref.quote: This is the third equation of motion.

steps: vi = 90 km h⁻¹ = 25 m s⁻¹; vf = 0; S = 125 m

blocks.prompt:
13 What is projectile motion? Explain the motion of a projectile fired at angle θ with the horizontal by resolving it into horizontal and vertical components, and find the magnitude and direction of its velocity at any instant. (5 marks)
(Projectile motion kya hai? Ufuq se θ angle par phainke gaye projectile ki harkat ko ufuqi aur amoodi components mein tor kar samjhayein, aur kisi lamhe us ki velocity ki magnitude aur simt nikalein.)
blocks.explanation:
Projectile motion gravity ke mustaqil acceleration ke tehat do-dimensional harkat hai. Misalein: khilari ki kick ki hui football, cricketer ki phainki gend, launching pad se chalaya missile.

Ufuqi phainka gaya: Unchai se vx velocity se ufuqi phainki gayi gend par koi ufuqi force nahi (hawa ki rugar nazar-andaaz), is liye x = vx × t ... (2.17). Amoodi harkat sifr amoodi velocity se free fall hai: y = ½gt².

θ angle par phainka gaya (Fig. 2.8 b): vi ko vi cos θ (ufuqi) aur vi sin θ (amoodi) mein torein. Dono harkatein aik doosre se aazad hain.
Ufuqi: ax = 0, is liye ufuqi component mustaqil:
vfx = vix = vi cos θ ... (2.18)
Amoodi: oopar ki harkat mein ay = -g; pehli equation se:
vfy = vi sin θ - gt ... (2.19)

Kisi lamhe velocity:
Magnitude: v = √(vfx² + vfy²) ... (2.20)
Ufuq se simt: tan φ = vfy/vfx ... (2.21)

book_ref.quote: the motion of a projectile can be studied easily by resolving it into horizontal and vertical components

blocks.prompt:
14 A ball is thrown horizontally at 12 m s⁻¹ from the top of a building 44.1 m high. Find (i) the time to reach the ground (ii) the horizontal distance covered (iii) its velocity on striking the ground. (3 marks)
(Aik gend 44.1 m oonchi building ki chhat se 12 m s⁻¹ se ufuqi phainki jati hai. Nikalein: (i) zameen tak pohanchne ka waqt (ii) ufuqi faasla (iii) zameen se takrate waqt us ki velocity.)
blocks.explanation: Amoodi harkat sifr amoodi velocity se free fall hai; ufuqi velocity 12 m s⁻¹ rehti hai. Aakhir mein dono components milayein.

book_ref.quote: Suppose that the ball leaves the hand of the thrower at point A

steps: vfy = 9.8 × 3 = 29.4 m s⁻¹ (neeche); vfx = 12 m s⁻¹
blocks.final_answer: t = 3 s; x = 36 m; v = 31.8 m s⁻¹, ufuq se 67.8° neeche

blocks.prompt:
15 Define the time of flight and the maximum height of a projectile. Derive their expressions for a projectile fired from the ground with velocity vi at angle θ. What is the effect of air resistance on the height? (5 marks)
(Projectile ke time of flight aur maximum height ki definition likhein. Zameen se vi velocity aur θ angle par phainke gaye projectile ke liye un ke formulas derive karein. Hawa ki rukawat ka unchai par kya asar hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Time of flight: phainke jane ki jagah se zameen se takrane ki jagah tak jism ka liya gaya waqt.
Jism oopar ja kar wapas usi satah par aata hai, is liye amoodi displacement S = h = 0. Velocity ka amoodi component vi sin θ aur a = -g:
S = vit + ½at² se 0 = vi sin θ t - ½gt²
t se taqseem: t = 2vi sin θ / g ... (2.23)

Maximum height: Amoodi harkat par 2aS = vf² - vi² lagayein; a = -g, ibtidai amoodi velocity vi sin θ, sab se oopar amoodi velocity 0, S = h:
-2gh = 0 - vi² sin²θ
h = vi² sin²θ / 2g ... (2.22)

Hawa ki rukawat: projectile ki oopar ki velocity kam karti hai, is liye unchai kam ho jati hai.

book_ref.quote: Hence, the equation of motion is:

blocks.prompt:
16 A shell is fired from the ground at 40 m s⁻¹ at 60° above the horizontal. Find (i) its time of flight (ii) the maximum height it reaches. (3 marks)
(Aik gola zameen se 40 m s⁻¹ se ufuq se 60° oopar chalaya jata hai. Nikalein: (i) us ka time of flight (ii) us ki maximum unchai.)
blocks.explanation: Dono jawab sirf amoodi component vi sin θ par munhasir hain; oopar derive kiye gaye formulas lagayein.

book_ref.quote: the initial vertical velocity viy = vi sin θ

blocks.final_answer: Time of flight = 7.07 s; maximum height = 61.2 m

blocks.prompt:
17 Define the range of a projectile and derive its expression. On what does it depend? How do the height and range change for angles below and above 45°, and how does air resistance affect the range and the path? (5 marks)
(Projectile ki range ki definition likhein aur us ka formula derive karein. Yeh kis par munhasir hai? 45° se kam aur zyada angles par unchai aur range kaise badalti hain, aur hawa ki rukawat range aur raaste par kya asar dalti hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Range: projectile ka ufuqi rukh mein tay kiya gaya zyada se zyada faasla.

Derivation: Velocity ke ufuqi component ko kul time of flight se zarb dein:
R = vix × t = vi cos θ × (2vi sin θ / g)
R = (vi²/g) 2 sin θ cos θ
2 sin θ cos θ = sin 2θ, is liye:
R = (vi²/g) sin 2θ ... (2.24)
Yani range phainkne ki velocity aur angle par munhasir hai.

Maximum range: sin 2θ = 1 par, yani 2θ = 90°, θ = 45°.
45° se kam angle par unchai aur range dono kam; 45° se zyada par unchai zyada magar range phir kam.

Hawa ki rukawat: aage ki harkat sust kar ke vi kam karti hai, is liye range kam hoti hai. Yeh parwaaz mein mustaqil nahi (jism sust ho to kam), is liye raasta mukammal parabola nahi balkay tircha hota hai, utaar charhaai se zyada dhalwan; tez projectile parabola se chhota reh jata hai.

book_ref.quote: As 2 sin θ cos θ = sin 2θ

blocks.prompt:
18 A ball is kicked from level ground at 35 m s⁻¹. Find its range when it is kicked at (i) 45° (ii) 30° to the horizontal. (3 marks)
(Hamwaar zameen se aik gend 35 m s⁻¹ se kick ki jati hai. Us ki range nikalein jab use ufuq se (i) 45° (ii) 30° par kick kiya jaye.)
blocks.explanation: Har angle ke liye R = (vi²/g) sin 2θ lagayein; 45° par range zyada honi chahiye.

book_ref.quote: Determine the height to which it rises, the time of flight and the horizontal range.

blocks.final_answer: 45° par R = 125 m; 30° par R = 108 m (45° par range sab se zyada)

blocks.prompt:
19 Define linear momentum and impulse. Show that the change in momentum of a body equals the product of force and time, and hence state Newton's second law in terms of momentum. Why is this form more general than F = ma? (5 marks)
(Linear momentum aur impulse ki definition likhein. Sabit karein ke jism ke momentum ki tabdeeli force aur waqt ke hasil-e-zarb ke barabar hai, aur is se Newton ka doosra qanoon momentum ki zabaan mein bayan karein. Yeh shakal F = ma se zyada aam kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Linear momentum: p = mv ... (2.25). Yeh velocity ki simt mein vector hai; SI unit kg m s⁻¹ (= N s).

Force se taalluq: m mass ke jism ki initial velocity vi hai. Bairooni force F us par t waqt amal karti hai, phir velocity vf ho jati hai. Acceleration:
a = (vf - vi)/t
Newton ke doosre qanoon se a = F/m. Barabar karne se:
F/m = (vf - vi)/t
F × t = mvf - mvi ... (2.26)
mvi ibtidai aur mvf aakhri momentum hai. Yani momentum ki tabdeeli force aur us ke waqt ke hasil-e-zarb ke barabar hai.

Momentum ki zabaan mein doosra qanoon: F = (mvf - mvi)/t, yani momentum ki tabdeeli ki waqt ke saath sharah lagayi gayi force ke barabar hai.

Impulse: jab force bohat kam waqt ke liye lage aur har lamhe badle (maslan bat gend ko maare), to average force aur waqt ka hasil-e-zarb lete hain:
Impulse = F × t = mvf - mvi ... (2.27)

Zyada aam: yeh shakal un haalaat par bhi lagti hai jahan acceleration ke dauran mass badle, maslan rocket jis ka fuel jal kar nikalta hai.

book_ref.quote: Suppose an external force F⃗ acts upon it for time t after which velocity becomes

blocks.prompt:
20 A 0.15 kg ball reaches a batsman at 30 m s⁻¹ and is hit straight back at 20 m s⁻¹. The bat is in contact with the ball for 0.01 s. Find (i) the impulse on the ball (ii) the average force exerted by the bat. (3 marks)
(0.15 kg ki gend batsman tak 30 m s⁻¹ se aati hai aur seedhi 20 m s⁻¹ se wapas maari jati hai. Bat 0.01 s gend se mila rehta hai. Nikalein: (i) gend par impulse (ii) bat ki lagayi average force.)
blocks.explanation: Momentum vector hai: wapas aati velocity ka nishan ulat rakhein, phir impulse = mvf - mvi aur F = impulse/t.

book_ref.quote: How large was the average retarding force?

steps: Aane ki simt positive: vi = +30, vf = -20 m s⁻¹
blocks.final_answer: Impulse = 7.5 N s aur average force = 750 N, dono aane wali gend ke ulat (bowler ki taraf)

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Manfi nishan sirf simt batata hai: force gend ki ibtidai harkat ke ulat hai. Agar wapas aane ki velocity ka nishan na badlein to ghalat jawab 1.5 N s aata hai.

blocks.prompt:
21 What is an isolated system? Derive the law of conservation of linear momentum for two colliding balls and state the law. (5 marks)
(Isolated system kya hai? Do takrane wali gendon ke liye linear momentum ke tahaffuz ka qanoon derive karein aur qanoon bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Isolated system: aisa system jis par koi bairooni cheez force na lagaye, maslan sheeshe ke bartan mein mustaqil temperature par band gas ke molecules.

Derivation: m1 aur m2 mass ki do hamwaar sakht gendein aik hi line par aik hi simt mein v1 aur v2 se chalti hain. Takrane ke baad un ki velocities v1′ aur v2′ hain (Fig. 2.9). Takkar (waqt t) mein gend 2, gend 1 par F aur gend 1, gend 2 par F′ lagati hai. F × t = momentum ki tabdeeli se:
m1 ke liye: F × t = m1v1′ - m1v1
m2 ke liye: F′ × t = m2v2′ - m2v2
Jama: (F + F′) t = (m1v1′ - m1v1) + (m2v2′ - m2v2)
Amal aur radd-e-amal barabar aur ulat: F′ = -F, is liye F + F′ = 0:
m1v1 + m2v2 = m1v1′ + m2v2′ ... (2.28)
Takkar se pehle kul momentum = takkar ke baad kul momentum; isolated system ke kul momentum ki tabdeeli sifr hai.

Qanoon: Isolated system ka kul linear momentum mustaqil rehta hai.
Momentum vector hai, is liye lagate waqt simt (nishan) ka khayal rakhein.

book_ref.quote: Adding these two expressions, we have

blocks.prompt:
22 A 4 kg ball moving at 5 m s⁻¹ and a 6 kg ball moving at 2 m s⁻¹ approach each other and collide. After the collision the 4 kg ball moves back at 1 m s⁻¹. Find the velocity of the 6 kg ball after the collision. (3 marks)
(5 m s⁻¹ se chalti 4 kg ki gend aur 2 m s⁻¹ se chalti 6 kg ki gend aik doosre ki taraf aa kar takrati hain. Takkar ke baad 4 kg wali gend 1 m s⁻¹ se wapas chalti hai. Takkar ke baad 6 kg wali gend ki velocity nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: 4 kg wali gend ki ibtidai simt positive lein, ulat velocities ko manfi nishan dein, aur pehle aur baad ka kul momentum barabar karein.

book_ref.quote: What must be the velocity of the smaller ball after collision

steps: 8 = -4 + 6 v2′, is liye v2′ = 2 m s⁻¹
blocks.final_answer: v2′ = +2 m s⁻¹: 6 kg wali gend 4 kg wali gend ki asal simt mein 2 m s⁻¹ se chalti hai (yani mur jati hai)

blocks.prompt:
23 Distinguish elastic from inelastic collisions. For an elastic collision of two balls in one dimension, show that the relative velocity of approach equals the relative velocity of separation, write the final velocities, and discuss the cases m1 = m2 with v2 = 0, and a light body hitting a massive body at rest. (5 marks)
(Elastic aur inelastic takkar mein farq batayein. Aik dimension mein do gendon ki elastic takkar ke liye sabit karein ke approach ki relative velocity separation ki relative velocity ke barabar hai, final velocities likhein, aur m1 = m2 (v2 = 0) aur halke jism ki sakoon wale bhaari jism se takkar ke cases bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Elastic takkar: K.E. zaya nahi hoti (perfectly elastic). Inelastic takkar: system ki K.E. conserve nahi hoti. Momentum aur kul energy har takkar mein conserve hain.

Do hamwaar, na ghoomne wali gendein m1, m2 aik simt mein v1, v2 se aur takkar ke baad v1′, v2′ se chalti hain (Fig. 2.10). Daayen taraf positive.
Momentum: m1v1 + m2v2 = m1v1′ + m2v2′
m1(v1 - v1′) = m2(v2′ - v2) ... (2.29)
K.E. (elastic): ½m1v1² + ½m2v2² = ½m1v1′² + ½m2v2′²
m1(v1 + v1′)(v1 - v1′) = m2(v2′ + v2)(v2′ - v2) ... (2.30)
(2.30) ko (2.29) se taqseem:
v1 + v1′ = v2′ + v2 ... (2.31)
(v1 - v2) = -(v1′ - v2′)
Yani relative velocity ki magnitude pehle aur baad barabar hai magar simt ulat: approach ki relative velocity = separation ki relative velocity.

(2.29) aur (2.30) hal karne se:
v1′ = (m1 - m2)/(m1 + m2) v1 + 2m2/(m1 + m2) v2 ... (2.32)
v2′ = 2m1/(m1 + m2) v1 + (m2 - m1)/(m1 + m2) v2 ... (2.33)

m1 = m2, v2 = 0: v1′ = 0, v2′ = v1. Pehli gend ruk jati hai, doosri us ki velocity se chal parti hai (billiard).
m2 >> m1, v2 = 0: v1′ = -v1, v2′ = 0. Halki gend usi speed se wapas aati hai (squash).

book_ref.quote: By applying the law of conservation of momentum we have

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: (2.30) ko (2.29) se taqseem karte waqt m1(v1 - v1′) aur m2(v2′ - v2) dono taraf cut jaate hain; is liye sirf velocities ka jor (v1 + v1′ = v2 + v2′) bachta hai.

blocks.prompt:
24 A 0.2 kg ball moving at 5 m s⁻¹ makes a head-on elastic collision with a 0.3 kg ball at rest. Find the velocities of both balls after the collision and show that kinetic energy is conserved. (3 marks)
(5 m s⁻¹ se chalti 0.2 kg ki gend sakoon wali 0.3 kg ki gend se seedhi elastic takkar karti hai. Takkar ke baad dono ki velocities nikalein aur dikhayein ke kinetic energy conserve hai.)
blocks.explanation: Eqs. (2.32) aur (2.33) mein v2 = 0 rakhein, phir pehle aur baad ki kul K.E. ka muqabla karein.

book_ref.quote: If the collision were perfectly elastic.

blocks.final_answer: v1′ = -1 m s⁻¹ (wapas), v2′ = 4 m s⁻¹; K.E. pehle aur baad 2.5 J, yani conserve

blocks.prompt:
25 What is meant by an elastic collision in two dimensions? For a projectile m1 striking a target m2 at rest, write the conservation equations along the x- and y-axes and for kinetic energy, and explain how they show that a collision is elastic. (5 marks)
(Do dimensions mein elastic takkar se kya muraad hai? Projectile m1 ki sakoon wale target m2 se takkar ke liye x aur y axes par aur kinetic energy ke tahaffuz ki masawaat likhein, aur batayein ke yeh takkar ke elastic hone ko kaise sabit karti hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Do-dimensional takkar: aik axis par chalte ajsaam takkar ke baad usi axis par nahi chalte (tircha, seedha nahi). Elastic ho to kul linear momentum aur kul kinetic energy dono conserve hote hain.

Surat-e-haal (Fig. 2.15): projectile m1 x-axis par v1i se; target m2 sakoon mein (v2i = 0). Takkar ke baad v1f, θ1 par aur v2f, θ2 par, x-axis ke mukhalif taraf.
Ibtidai momentum = m1v1i (x par); target ka sifr. m1v1f ko m1v1f cos θ1 aur m1v1f sin θ1 mein, aur m2v2f ko m2v2f cos θ2 aur m2v2f sin θ2 mein torein.

x-axis: m1v1i = m1v1f cos θ1 + m2v2f cos θ2 ... (2.34)
y-axis: m1v1f sin θ1 = m2v2f sin θ2 ... (2.35)
Kinetic energy: m1v1i² = m1v1f² + m2v2f² ... (2.36)

Chaar na-maloom hain: v1f, v2f, θ1, θ2. Agar naap kar yeh (2.34), (2.35) aur (2.36) poori karein to momentum aur K.E. dono conserve hain aur takkar elastic hai.

book_ref.quote: The initial momentum of projectile before collision is m₁v⃗₁i

blocks.prompt:
26 A 2 kg ball moving at 5 m s⁻¹ along the x-axis strikes an identical ball at rest. After the collision the first ball moves at 4 m s⁻¹ at 37° above the x-axis and the second at 3 m s⁻¹ at 53° below it. Show that momentum is conserved along both axes and that the collision is elastic. (3 marks)
(x-axis par 5 m s⁻¹ se chalti 2 kg ki gend waisi hi sakoon wali gend se takrati hai. Takkar ke baad pehli gend x-axis se 37° oopar 4 m s⁻¹ se aur doosri 53° neeche 3 m s⁻¹ se chalti hai. Dikhayein ke dono axes par momentum conserve hai aur takkar elastic hai.)
blocks.explanation: x par Eq. (2.34), y par Eq. (2.35) aur K.E. ke liye Eq. (2.36) jaanchein.

book_ref.quote: is moving with initial velocity 5 m s⁻¹ towards right collides with stationary target

steps: x: pehle 10 kg m s⁻¹; baad 6.39 + 3.61 = 10.0 kg m s⁻¹
y: pehle 0; baad 4.81 - 4.79 = 0.02 ≈ 0 (yeh maamooli farq sirf angles ko 37° aur 53° tak round karne se hai)
blocks.final_answer: x aur y par momentum conserve hai aur K.E. pehle aur baad 25 J: takkar elastic hai

blocks.prompt:
27 What is a perfectly inelastic collision? For such a collision in one dimension, find the common velocity of the bodies and show that the fraction of kinetic energy lost is m2/(m1 + m2) when the target is at rest. (5 marks)
(Perfectly inelastic takkar kya hai? Aik dimension mein aisi takkar ke liye ajsaam ki mushtarka velocity nikalein aur dikhayein ke target sakoon mein ho to zaya K.E. ka hissa m2/(m1 + m2) hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Perfectly inelastic takkar woh hai jis mein takrane wale ajsaam jur kar aik jism ki tarah chalte hain. Momentum conserve hota hai, K.E. nahi.

Mushtarka velocity: m1 (projectile) aur m2 (target) aik line par v1i aur v2i (v1i > v2i) se chal kar takrate aur jur jaate hain; mushtarka mass m1 + m2, vf se chalta hai (Fig. 2.16). Momentum ke tahaffuz se:
m1v1i + m2v2i = (m1 + m2)vf
vf = m1/(m1 + m2) v1i + m2/(m1 + m2) v2i
Target sakoon mein (v2i = 0):
vf = m1/(m1 + m2) v1i ... (2.37)
m1 ki velocity mass ratio m1/(m1 + m2) se kam ho jati hai; m1 jitna bara, jora utna tez.

Kinetic energy:
(K.E)i = ½m1v1i² + ½m2v2i²; (K.E)f = ½(m1 + m2)vf²
Zaya hissa = [(K.E)i - (K.E)f]/(K.E)i
v2i = 0 aur (2.37) se vf rakhne par:
= 1 - m1/(m1 + m2)
= m2/(m1 + m2) ... (2.38)
Yani aik-dimensional inelastic takkar mein K.E. zaya hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Since the collision is perfectly inelastic, the total momentum of balls is conserved.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: (K.E)f/(K.E)i = (m1 + m2)(m1/(m1 + m2))²/m1 = m1/(m1 + m2). Is liye zaya hissa 1 - m1/(m1 + m2) = m2/(m1 + m2) hai.

blocks.prompt:
28 A 3 kg trolley moving at 8 m s⁻¹ collides with a 1 kg trolley at rest and they move off together. Find (i) the common velocity (ii) the K.E. lost (iii) check the fraction lost with m2/(m1 + m2). (3 marks)
(8 m s⁻¹ se chalti 3 kg ki trolley sakoon wali 1 kg ki trolley se takra kar saath chal parti hai. Nikalein: (i) mushtarka velocity (ii) zaya K.E. (iii) zaya hisse ko m2/(m1 + m2) se jaanchein.)
blocks.explanation: vf ke liye Eq. (2.37), dono kinetic energies nikalein, phir zaya hisse ko Eq. (2.38) se milayein.

book_ref.quote: Show law of conservation of momentum and energy losses during perfect inelastic collision.

blocks.final_answer: vf = 6 m s⁻¹; zaya K.E. = 24 J (ibtidai K.E. ka chautha hissa)

blocks.prompt:
29 Explain a perfectly inelastic collision in two dimensions. Write the momentum equations along the x- and y-axes and obtain the magnitude and direction of the common final velocity. How is the loss of kinetic energy found? (5 marks)
(Do dimensions mein perfectly inelastic takkar samjhayein. x aur y axes par momentum ki masawaat likhein aur mushtarka final velocity ki magnitude aur simt nikalein. Kinetic energy ka nuqsaan kaise maloom hota hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Macroscopic takkarein aam tor par inelastic hoti hain aur K.E. conserve nahi karti. Perfectly inelastic takkar mein ajsaam jur kar aik mass ban jaate hain.

Do ajsaam m1 aur m2 xy-plane mein v1i aur v2i se x-axis se θ1 aur θ2 angles par chal kar origin par takrate hain (Fig. 2.17). Takkar ke baad mushtarka mass M = m1 + m2, vf se x-axis se φ angle par chalta hai. Components banane se:
x-rukh: m1v1i cos θ1 + m2v2i cos θ2 = Mvf cos φ ... (2.39)
y-rukh: m1v1i sin θ1 + m2v2i sin θ2 = Mvf sin φ ... (2.40)

Magnitude ((2.39) aur (2.40) ka murabba le kar jama):
vf = √{[(m1v1i cos θ1 + m2v2i cos θ2)/M]² + [(m1v1i sin θ1 + m2v2i sin θ2)/M]²} ... (2.41)
Simt ((2.40) ko (2.39) se taqseem):
φ = tan⁻¹[(m1v1i sin θ1 + m2v2i sin θ2)/(m1v1i cos θ1 + m2v2i cos θ2)] ... (2.42)

Kinetic energy (scalar, components ki zaroorat nahi):
(K.E)i = ½m1v1i² + ½m2v2i² ... (2.43)
(K.E)f = ½Mvf² ... (2.44)
Nuqsaan: Δ(K.E) = (K.E)i - (K.E)f; yeh energy garmi, awaz ya deformation mein badal jati hai.

book_ref.quote: Its analysis can be carried out as follows:

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab mein likha hai ke φ ke liye (2.40) ko (2.41) se taqseem karein; yeh chhapai ki ghalti hai. Durust tareeqa: y-momentum (2.40) ko x-momentum (2.39) se taqseem karein.

blocks.prompt:
31 Explain the principle of rocket propulsion. Why can a rocket work where there is no air, why are rockets built in several linked parts, and how does its acceleration change during the flight? (5 marks)
(Rocket propulsion ka usool samjhayein. Rocket hawa ke baghair kyun kaam kar sakta hai, kai jore hue hisson mein kyun banaya jata hai, aur parwaaz ke dauran us ka acceleration kaise badalta hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Usool: Rocket peeche ke engines se jalti gas nikal kar chalta hai. Fuel aur oxygen combustion chamber mein milte hain; jalta fuel tez dabao wali gas ban kar bohat tez nikalta hai (Fig. 2.18). Gas aur rocket aik doosre ko dhakel kar ulat simton mein chalte hain: rocket nikli gas ke momentum ke barabar magar ulat simt mein momentum leta hai (momentum ka tahaffuz). Engines gas nikalte rahein to rocket momentum leta aur tez hota jata hai.

Hawa ki zaroorat nahi: rocket apna fuel liquid ya solid hydrogen aur oxygen ki shakal mein saath le jata hai, is liye bohat unchai par bhi kaam karta hai. Aam rocket taqreeban 10000 kg s⁻¹ fuel kharch karta aur gases 4000 m s⁻¹ se zyada raftaar se nikalta hai.

Jore hue rockets: launch mass ka 80% se zyada fuel hai. Rocket kai rockets jor kar banaya jata hai; jab aik ka kaam khatam ho to alag kar diya jata hai aur baqi craft ko aur zyada speed se aage le jaate hain.

Acceleration: agar m har second nikalne wali gas ka mass aur v rocket ke lehaaz se us ki velocity ho, to gas ke momentum ki fi second tabdeeli mv hai, jo rocket par thrust ke barabar hai. Is liye
a = mv/M
jahan M rocket ka mass hai. Fuel jal kar nikalta hai to M kam hota hai, is liye acceleration barhta hai.

book_ref.quote: Rockets move by expelling burning gas through engines at their rear.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab is masawat ko (2.42) number deti hai jo pehle hi φ ke liye istemal ho chuka hai; durust naya number (2.45) hona chahiye.

blocks.prompt:
32 A rocket ejects 10000 kg of burnt gas per second at 4000 m s⁻¹ relative to it. Find the thrust and its acceleration (a = mv/M) when its mass is (i) 5.0 × 10⁶ kg (ii) 2.5 × 10⁶ kg. (3 marks)
(Aik rocket har second 10000 kg jali hui gas 4000 m s⁻¹ (apne lehaaz se) se nikalta hai. Thrust aur us ka acceleration (a = mv/M) nikalein jab us ka mass (i) 5.0 × 10⁶ kg (ii) 2.5 × 10⁶ kg ho.)
blocks.explanation: Thrust = gas ke momentum ki fi second tabdeeli = mv; har case mein rocket ke mass se taqseem karein.

book_ref.quote: This equals the thrust produced by the engine on the body of the rocket.

blocks.final_answer: Thrust = 4.0 × 10⁷ N; 5.0 × 10⁶ kg par a = 8.0 m s⁻² aur 2.5 × 10⁶ kg par 16 m s⁻² (mass aadha, acceleration dugna)
